Fourteen ways to build an AI business alone. Pick one problem, not fourteen side hustles.
Offer a service: teach teams, make content, improve search visibility, manage ads, automate workflows, handle customer replies, own an ongoing outcome, advise on AI, or build software for one client.
Prefer a longer game? Build an audience, sell a digital product, run a paid community or newsletter, resell software under your brand, or create your own app.
Start with a real customer problem, test your offer, and refine it. None of these guarantees income.
